# RX Tracker NEXT v4.0.0-next.82

Performance-focused release for the Patients, RX Records, and Call Center
workflows.

## Changed

- Deferred patient address autocomplete loading until address fields are used,
  with a short server-side cache for the address lookup payload.
- Reduced RX Records default list work by calculating current workflow dates
  only for the returned page unless workflow filters or sorting require the
  full workflow projection.
- Replaced the RX modal patient picker startup preload with a lightweight
  on-demand active-patient lookup.
- Optimized the Call Center queue by loading page details, call history, recent
  notes, and eligible-patient metrics through bounded SQL queries.

## Database

- Added audited indexes for structured patient address filters.
- Added audited indexes for Call Center queue eligibility, active call
  attempts, and active lock lookups.

## Validation

- Verified the full-copy test database at 63 applied migrations, 0 pending
  migrations, and a verified checksum ledger.
- Passed public JavaScript validation, RX pipeline filter parity, Call Center
  pagination, Call Center queue reopen, Call Center call-attempt lifecycle, and
  migration checksum drift regression tests.

No proxy, VPN, FortiGate, cookie, `.env`, port, login/session, service
bootstrap, configured RX Action, or business-data rule is changed.
